ActChannel.description:
Channel subset legal on the act-chain. `vision` is structurally excluded
(principle 7: vision never locates or acts).

oneOf.description: Static-coordinate channel (must carry literal coordinates, bind-phase check).

ActionBinding.description:
Ordered, closed act-chain. No declared fallback ⇒ exactly one attempt
(principle 6: the runner never improvises a downgrade).

attempts.description:
The attempts, in declared order. A subsequent attempt is tried only
after `action_failed_final` of the previous one (spine §6.2).

ActionName.description: Provider-native action name (DeviceRail camelCase, e.g. 'tapElement'). Canonical verbs never appear here; provider-qualified names ('<provider>:<action>') are reserved for multi-provider futures and rejected in v0.1.

ActionStepIR.description:
Action step (02 §4.1): fixed pipeline `preflight? → act → observe → assert`.

`assertions` MAY be empty: a mutating action step without assertions
yields no verdict (report annotation `unverified`, spine R4).

assertions.description: Post-hoc assertions. Empty array ⇒ this step yields no verdict.

checkpoint.description:
Whether to materialize a checkpoint at this step boundary. Required
because sealed IR materializes all defaulted fields
(single-representation rule; default true, false inside macro
expansions).

effect.description: `mutating | readonly` (`pure` is excluded — it belongs to `let`).

effectHash.description: Canonical hash of "what this step does to the world" (02 §12.3).

handlers.description: Step-level handler hooks; override flow-level ones.

idempotent.description:
Author-declared idempotence (materialized default: false). Governs
timed-out auto-retry and reconcile-uncertain replay permission.

judgeHash.description: Canonical hash of "how this step is judged" (02 §12.3).

outputSchema.description: Data contract of the projected output, for downstream static checks.

outputs.description:
Output projection: `Record<name, Expr>` over `ActionResult.output` /
observation metadata. Self-refs inside refer to the *raw* output
(02 §4.1.1). Absent ⇒ identity projection.

preflight.description:
Pre-entry world probes; double as resume drift detection
(spine §6.7-C). Distinct from post-hoc `assertions` (`expect`).

retry.description: Retry policy — applies to the act phase only (spine §6.5 mount 1).

verb.description:
Canonical verb — pure metadata for reports; the runner has no verb
switch (spine R7).

AssertStepIR.description: Assert step (02 §4.2): side-effect-free observation and judgment.

assertions.description: At least one assertion (an assertion-free assert step is meaningless).

checkpoint.description:
Whether to materialize a checkpoint at this step boundary. Required
because sealed IR materializes all defaulted fields
(single-representation rule; default true, false inside macro
expansions).

judgeHash.description: Canonical hash of "how this step is judged" (02 §12.3).

observe.description:
Observation source: fresh capture or reuse of an action step's
before/after observation (offline re-judgeable).

Pre-entry world probes; double as resume drift detection
(spine §6.7-C). Distinct from post-hoc `assertions` (`expect`).

retry.description: Retry policy — applies to the act phase only (spine §6.5 mount 1).

AssertionIR.description:
A single assertion with its explicit verify-chain.

The three baseline `allOf` conditionals are reproduced on the generated
schema via `#[schemars(extend)]`:
1. `expr` predicates consume no observation channel (`verifyVia: []`);
   all other predicates need at least one channel.
2. `visual` predicates are vision-only (`verifyVia == ["vision"]`).
3. For `elementState`/`elementText`, `visionPrompt` is required iff the
   chain contains `vision`, forbidden otherwise (03 §1.4 rule 5; the
   compiler never synthesizes vision prompts, principle 6).

"vision only at the chain tail" is order-sensitive and remains a
bind-phase check (not expressible in JSON Schema).

assertId.description: Stable assertion id (unique within the step).

onMissingInput.description:
Const `"unknown"` (principle 4): a channel that cannot complete
evaluation yields unknown for that channel and the chain advances; an
exhausted chain yields unknown. A completed negative is final
(spine R5).

verifyVia.description:
Explicit, ordered verify-chain — a subsequence of `[dom, uiTree,
vision]`. Order carries semantics (degradation order) and participates
verbatim in `judgeHash` (02 §12.1 rule 5). Uniqueness is enforced by
the schema (`uniqueItems`), not by this type.

visionPrompt.description:
Author-written vision prompt, handed verbatim to the VisionVerifier
when `vision` is the declared degraded tail of an
`elementState`/`elementText` verify-chain (YAML surface key `visual`).
Required iff such a chain contains `vision`, forbidden otherwise.
Part of the assertion, hence inside the `judgeHash` domain (02 §12.3).

BackoffMs.description:
Backoff declaration: a plain number of milliseconds, or an exponential
schedule. Numbers use `serde_json::Number` so integers round-trip
canonically (02 §12.1 rule 4).

BoundAttempt.description:
One fully bound attempt of the act-chain (02 §5.1).

`protection` is const `"standard"` in v0.1: bind rejects protected
actions (spine R6). `coordinate` attempts must carry literal static
coordinates in `args` (bind-phase check).

acceptExecutionModes.description:
Whitelist of daemon-internal execution modes (spine §6.4 R-degrade).
Derived per attempt from its own `channel` only; semantic attempts
never include `coordinateFallback`. Set semantics — serialized in
declaration order of [`ExecutionMode`], deduplicated on load.

args.description:
Arguments as expressions; shape-checked against the action's
`inputSchema` at bind time and re-checked after evaluation at runtime.

channel.description:
Locating channel — [`ActChannel`], so `vision` is structurally
impossible here (principle 7).

CallStepIR.description:
Call step (02 §6): subflow invocation. Callee pinned by content hash
(`flowRef.irHash` must appear in `FlowIR.subflows`). Call-by-value:
`inputs` are evaluated in the caller scope and snapshotted.

checkpoint.description:
Whether to materialize a checkpoint at this step boundary. Required
because sealed IR materializes all defaulted fields
(single-representation rule; default true, false inside macro
expansions).

handlers.description: Step-level handler hooks; override flow-level ones.

judgeHash.description: Canonical hash of "how this step is judged" (02 §12.3).

(spine §6.7-C). Distinct from post-hoc `assertions` (`expect`).

retry.description: Retry policy — applies to the act phase only (spine §6.5 mount 1).

EffectClassAction.description:
`EffectClass` restricted for action steps; `pure` is excluded because pure
computation never crosses a Provider.

oneOf.description: Probes the world without changing it.

ElementSelectorIR.description:
Structured element selector (isomorphic to DeviceRail `ElementSelector`).

At least one property must be present (`minProperties: 1`) — enforced by
the schema; serde-side an all-`None` value is representable and left to
the compiler to reject.

context.description: UI context scoping (native/web, optional context id).

ElementState.description:
Element state predicate values — verbatim equal to DeviceRail
`WaitForElementCondition`.

oneOf.description: Element exists in the UI tree.

ErrorClass.description:
Pointlock-layer closed error taxonomy (spine §5). DeviceRail
`ErrorInfo.code` is an open string set mapped onto this enum.

snake_case on the wire, aligned with DeviceRail error-code style.

oneOf.description: Attestation does not match `lockfileDigest`; refuse to start/resume.
Runtime arguments failed the action inputSchema — a compiler/expression bug signal.
Action failed with `retryable: true` as reported by the daemon.
Action failed with `retryable: false`; try the next attempt or fail the step.
Action timed out; auto-retry only when the step is declared idempotent.
`UiNodeRef` documentEpoch invalid or locate miss; re-observe before retry.
Transport lost / daemon exited; suspend and resume from checkpoint.
Session degraded; current step yields unknown, flow-level onError fires.

ExecutionMode.description:
Actual execution mode reported by the DeviceRail daemon; the whitelist
semantics live on [`crate::BoundAttempt::accept_execution_modes`]
(spine §6.4 R-degrade).

oneOf.description: Daemon-internal coordinate fallback (must be whitelisted per attempt).

anyOf.description: Reference into the closed scope grammar.

Expr.description:
Expression node: exactly one of `lit` / `ref` / `fn` (02 §8.1).

Wire shape is the baseline schema's `oneOf` of three closed single-key
objects; the variants are mutually exclusive by their required keys, so
serde's untagged representation is deterministic.

ExprMap.description: Identifier-keyed map of expressions (exemption class 2: keys are data, constrained by propertyNames).

FeatureId.description: DeviceRail feature id passthrough (e.g. 'device.semanticActions.v1'); future Pointlock-owned features use the 'pointlock.' prefix.

FlowRef.description: Content-pinned reference to a compiled flow artifact.

irHash.description: The callee's content hash (integrity pin; runner verifies on load).

FnExpr.description:
Whitelisted pure-function application.

Arity is enforced by the schema (the `allOf` conditionals below mirror the
baseline); argument types plus the literal-only constraints (`jsonPath`
path, `regexMatch` pattern/flags) are enforced in the compiler `check`
phase (02 §8.2).

ForeachStepIR.description:
Foreach step (02 §4.6): iteration container. The iteration variable is
referenced via `iter.<as>`; `RunPath` disambiguates rounds with
`{ kind: "iteration", index }` frames, so body stepIds do not (and must
not) vary per round.

Whether to materialize a checkpoint at this step boundary. Required
because sealed IR materializes all defaulted fields
(single-representation rule; default true, false inside macro
expansions).

judgeHash.description: Canonical hash of "how this step is judged" (02 §12.3).

(spine §6.7-C). Distinct from post-hoc `assertions` (`expect`).

retry.description: Retry policy — applies to the act phase only (spine §6.5 mount 1).

HandlerAction.description:
The disposition produced by a handler; `kind` values are the closed
`Disposition` enum: `retry | continue | escalate | abort | repair`
(spine A.4). No variant carries outputs — error paths cannot enter the
data flow (spine R10).
Note on closedness: `#[schemars(deny_unknown_fields)]` closes each
variant object in the generated schema (baseline parity); serde's
internally-tagged deserialization is lenient about unknown fields at
runtime — the schema stays authoritative.

oneOf.description: Re-enter the step from `acting` with an independent retry budget.

policy.description: The retry policy for the re-entry.

oneOf.description: Escalate to a human node (compiler-synthesized stepId, 02 §3).

human.description: The embedded human step (boxed: much larger than sibling variants).

oneOf.description:
Run a repair subflow — no data outputs; afterwards re-probe
(`onResumeDrift`) or re-enter (`onFail`).

flowRef.description: The repair subflow, pinned like a `call`.

HandlerBinding.description:
A handler mounted on a hook.

The `errorClasses` filter is legal only on `onError` — the baseline
`if`/`else` conditional is reproduced via `#[schemars(extend)]`.

action.description: What to do when the hook fires.

errorClasses.description: Error-class filter — only meaningful (and only legal) on `onError`.

hook.description: The hook this handler fires on.

HandlerHook.description:
Handler hook points (spine A.4). Handlers never appear in normal control
flow; they fire on specific state-machine transitions.

oneOf.description: Fires when the step verdict folds to fail.
Fires when the step verdict folds to unknown.
Fires when resume preflight probes detect world drift.

Hash.description: Content hash, canonical form 'sha256:<64 lowercase hex>'.

HumanMode.description: Interaction mode of a human step (principle 8).

oneOf.description: Human confirms/rejects; the decision is recorded.
Human repairs the world; yields a disposition, never a verdict or output.

HumanStepIR.description:
Human step (02 §4.4): human collaboration is a formal node (principle 8).

`onTimeout` is const `"unknown"`: a human step that times out never
defaults to pass or fail (principles 4/8). `timeoutMs` is required
(unbounded waits are `runSuspended`, not silent hangs). The
`provideInput` ⇒ `outputSchema` requirement is a schema conditional.

LetStepIR.description:
Let step (02 §4.7): pure bindings into the `vars.*` scope, SSA single
assignment (rebinding an existing var name is a check-phase error).

LitExpr.description: Literal JSON value (any JSON type, including null).

MacroOriginFrame.description: One frame of a macro expansion chain.

file.description: The file containing the expansion site.

span.description: The span of the expansion site.

anyOf.description:
Reuse the referenced action step's archived observation — no device
contact, purely offline re-judgeable.

fromStep.description: The action step whose observation is reused.

ObservationSource.description: Where an assert step's observation comes from.

ObservationWhich.description: Which observation of the source action step an assert step reuses.

schema.description: JSON Schema contract of the value.

required.description: Whether the run must supply this parameter.

schema.description: JSON Schema contract of the value.

PredicateIR.description:
The four predicate types (closed, spine A.4), internally tagged `type`.

Note on closedness: `#[schemars(deny_unknown_fields)]` closes each
variant object in the generated schema (baseline parity); serde's
internally-tagged deserialization is lenient about unknown fields at
runtime (a documented serde limitation) — the schema stays authoritative.

oneOf.description:
Element state check; values equal DeviceRail
`WaitForElementCondition` verbatim.

Pure expression assertion over outputs (consumes no observation
channel; `verifyVia` is empty).

Visual assertion (vision-only; the prompt lives here, not in
`visionPrompt`).
`(any, string) → any` — path must be a literal string
`(string, string[, string]) → boolean` — pattern/flags must be literals

RectIR.description:
Rectangular region, field-compatible with DeviceRail `UiRect`.

Uses `serde_json::Number` (not `f64`) so integer inputs round-trip as
integers — required by the canonical-form rule that numbers keep their
shortest ES representation (02 §12.1).

RefExpr.description: Reference expression: a [`RefPath`] into the closed scope grammar.

RefPath.description: Closed scope grammar: params.* | env.* | vars.* | iter.* | steps.<id>.output(.field)* | steps.<id>.verdict. Dotted identifier segments only; array/deep access goes through the jsonPath pure function.

RetryPolicy.description:
Retry policy. Applies to the act phase only (spine §6.5 mount point 1);
each retry mints a new `callId` and a new `actionIntent` WAL record.

backoffMs.description: Backoff: fixed milliseconds or an exponential schedule.

retryOn.description:
Which error classes are retryable here. Semantically meaningful:
`action_failed_retryable`, `target_stale` (forces re-observe), and —
for idempotent steps — `action_timed_out`; `check` warns on the rest.
Set semantics — serialized in [`ErrorClass`] declaration order.

irPath.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into this FlowIR document.

origin.description:
Macro expansion chain, innermost first. Present iff the IR node was
produced by macro expansion — the only structural residue macros
leave in the IR (02 §7).

SourceSpan.description: A 1-based line/column span in a source file.

anyOf.description: `kind: "call"` — subflow invocation, pinned by content hash.

StepIR.description:
The closed step union (7 kinds, spine A.4), discriminated by `kind` on
the wire. See the module docs for why this is `untagged` in serde while
remaining a `kind`-tagged union on the wire.

StepId.description: Author-written ids use the first segment only ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*). ':'-separated segments are reserved for compiler-synthesized ids (e.g. handler-embedded human steps 'host:onFail:escalate'); synthesized ids never appear in ref paths.

TextMatchIR.description:
Text matcher (isomorphic to DeviceRail `TextMatch`).

`mode` and `caseSensitive` are required because sealed IR materializes
defaults (`exact` / `false`) — the single-representation rule (02 §2.4).

TextMatchMode.description: Text match mode — isomorphic to DeviceRail `TextMatchMode`.

UiContextKind.description: UI context kind — isomorphic to DeviceRail `UiContextKind`.

VerdictPolicy.description:
Flow-level verdict folding policy. `strict` folds a degraded pass into
`unknown` (spine §6.3).

VerifyChannel.description:
Channel subset legal on the verify-chain. `coordinate` is structurally
excluded (a coordinate cannot verify anything).

oneOf.description: Vision channel — only legal at the chain tail (bind-phase check).

description:
Pointlock Typed IR v0.1 — the sole input accepted by `pointlock-runner` and
the sole output of the `pointlock-compiler` seal phase.

Closed vocabulary per spine Appendix A. All objects are closed except the
three documented exemption classes (02 §2.2): embedded JSON Schema
documents, identifier-keyed maps, and `StepBase` (composed into variants).

irVersion.description: IR semantic-generation number, const `1` in v0.1.

lockfileDigest.description:
Digest of the `CapabilityLockfile` used at bind time; attestation
mismatch at runtime is `capability_drift`, refuse to run.

provider.description: The provider this flow was compiled against.

name.description: Const `"devicerail"` — the only provider of v0.1.

version.description: Provider package version the manifest came from.

requiredFeatures.description:
Union of features required by the whole flow; fed into
`FeatureOffer.required` at session open (free enforcement).
Set semantics — serialized in lexicographic order.

sourceMap.description:
IR path → YAML span mapping, plus macro origin traces. Pure
diagnostics: excluded from `irHash` (02 §12.2).

subflows.description:
Subflow registry: reference, not inline — callees are independent
artifacts pinned by `irHash` (02 §6).

verdictPolicy.description: Verdict folding policy (`strict` folds degraded pass to unknown).
